DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH) with associated sepsis and neonatal encephalopathy.

The clinical picture of a preterm infant with a history of chorioamnionitis, presenting with seizures, lethargy, and a tense fontanelle, combined with ultrasound evidence of intraventricular bleeding, strongly points to IVH. The infectious markers suggest a superimposed septic process complicating the hemorrhage.
